statement: Between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-06 UTC, US forces carry out at least one kinetic strike on a target on Iranian territory, including Iranian islands.
resolution: True if CENTCOM, or US officials quoted by at least two of Reuters, AP, CNN, NBC News and ABC News, confirm a US strike on Iranian territory carried out between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-06.
failure_condition: US forces carry out no strike on Iranian territory between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-06.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-04. Reference: 95.84 on the packet date.
resolution: True if any daily ICE Brent front-month settlement price from 2026-11-16 through 2026-12-04 is 100.00 USD or higher. Reference: 95.84 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement from 2026-11-16 through 2026-12-04 is below 100.00 USD per barrel.

statement: Anthropic Class A shares, ticker ANT, begin trading on Nasdaq between 2026-11-19 and 2026-12-04 and close their first trading day above the final IPO offer price. Reference at seal: filed range 70.00 to 78.00 USD, offer price not yet set.
resolution: True if the Nasdaq official closing price of ANT on its first trading day, falling between 2026-11-19 and 2026-12-04, is above the offer price in the final prospectus on SEC EDGAR.
failure_condition: ANT does not begin trading on Nasdaq between 2026-11-19 and 2026-12-04, or its first-day closing price is at or below the offer price.

statement: Between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26, Nvidia files a Form 8-K reporting that its board has appointed a chief executive officer who is not designated interim.
resolution: True if SEC EDGAR shows an Nvidia Form 8-K with a filing date between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26 reporting board appointment of a chief executive officer without interim or acting designation.
failure_condition: No Nvidia Form 8-K reporting the appointment of a non-interim chief executive officer is filed between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26.

statement: Between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-13, at least one named organization other than Cursor, Notion and Harvey publicly confirms that its own data or credentials were exposed through the October 2026 Fireworks AI security incidents.
resolution: True if BleepingComputer, The Register, TechCrunch or The Hacker News publishes, between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-13, a confirmation of such exposure attributed to an affected organization other than Cursor, Notion and Harvey.
failure_condition: No organization other than Cursor, Notion and Harvey confirms, between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-13, that its data or credentials were exposed through the Fireworks AI incidents.

statement: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin hold an in-person three-way meeting in Shenzhen, China, between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: True if a White House, Kremlin or Chinese Foreign Ministry readout, or both Reuters and AP, record all three leaders meeting together in person in Shenzhen between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-20 local time.
failure_condition: The three leaders do not meet together in person in Shenzhen between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-20.

statement: The International Court of Justice judgment in The Gambia v. Myanmar, scheduled for delivery on 2026-11-19, finds that Myanmar breached the Genocide Convention by committing genocide against the Rohingya.
resolution: True if the operative clause of the judgment delivered on 2026-11-19 and published on icj-cij.org declares that Myanmar violated the Genocide Convention by committing genocide. Any lesser finding, or none, is false.
failure_condition: The operative clause delivered on 2026-11-19 does not find that Myanmar committed genocide.

statement: The Knesset approves, in a confidence vote held between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-28, a new Israeli government with Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister.
resolution: True if the Knesset record shows a confidence vote passed between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-28 installing a government headed by Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister.
failure_condition: No government headed by Gadi Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-28.

statement: Between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31, at least one named person is criminally charged, in state or federal court, over the explosive device found on 2026-11-13 at an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois.
resolution: True if a US Department of Justice or Peoria County prosecutor announcement, or a court docket, shows a charge filed between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31 against a named person over the Peoria device.
failure_condition: No named person is charged over the Peoria device between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-13 UTC inside latitude 4 to 21 north, longitude 116 to 128 east, the box covering the Philippines.
resolution: True if a USGS ComCat query for magnitude 6.0 or greater, origin time 2026-11-16 through 2026-12-13 UTC, latitude 4 to 21 north, longitude 116 to 128 east, returns at least one event on the deadline date.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs inside that box between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-13 UTC.
